title: Account-to-ledger contract and authoritative balance views
workflow: Authenticate actor and account membership/mandate scope
Resolve authoritative ledger snapshot and as-of time
Compute posted and available balances separately
Apply approved holds and pending obligations without manufacturing postings
Return freshness and reconciliation status with values
Escalate unbalanced or stale snapshots to financial controls
invariants: Account service cannot directly mutate ledger tables
Available balance is not necessarily posted balance
Pending inbound funds may not be spendable without approved settlement evidence
Cross-currency conversion requires explicit reviewed rate source
Balance snapshots must reconcile to exact journal history
Failures must not return misleading zero as a fallback
planned_tests: Pending credit does not automatically increase posted amount
Ledger replay yields same as-of balance
approval_gate: CFO-approved balance semantics, verified accounting rules and ledger reconciliation tests.
